email.subject: Smile Dentistry: patients can't book or call from your site
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I checked Smile Dentistry's site and found two things likely costing you new patients: there's no online booking option, and no click-to-call button on mobile, so anyone searching on their phone has to manually dial or hunt for a contact form. Both are common reasons local patients give up and call a competitor instead. Your footer also still shows an old year, which is a minor trust ding but easy to fix.

I'm Alex, I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you the fixes on your actual site? No pressure either way.

Alex
